Hello,

I am looking for a narrow independent validation of a small public Lean release:

  • Repository: inaciovasquez2020/cslib-fmt

  • DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.20518144

  • Scope: finite graph diameter theorem stack only

  • Requested check: public repository, DOI, Lean build, and whether the stated finite graph diameter theorem stack is machine-checked as claimed

Moshe Vardi suggested looking at Mathlib activity and asking whether someone building libraries in model theory might be appropriate. I checked recent activity under Mathlib/ModelTheory, but I do not want to contact people directly from git-log data without community guidance.

Could someone recommend one or two Lean/Mathlib contributors who would be suitable for this narrow validation?

This is not a request for a broad research review or endorsement.

Best,
Inacio Vasquez
